known_differences: The native Stitch desktop export is only 1,024 CSS px high and does not cover the observed 4,757px internal scroll; the mobile export is about 3,030 CSS px high versus the 7,736px observed mobile scroll. Both outputs are preserved, not served directly.
The public draft uses dated server-rendered official markup, inlined CSS and captured artwork to restore all sections. Original Gatsby hydration and analytics scripts were removed.
Carousel tab switching, command copy and cloud selector use small static replacements; other OS controls and mobile navigation have not passed interaction review.
Live signup/social-proof numbers and official product content can change after capture.
Rendered comparison against current desktop and mobile official layouts remains pending, so exact parity is unverified.
